requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / sprite production. Create a TRANSPARENT PNG SOURCE of actual authored animation poses for approved Ma Khuyển (Demon Hound), NOT concept art or a collage. Input1 is approved individual concept, input2 approved master, input3 actual previous production sprites for style/scale. Reproduce exact quadruped design: charcoal/crimson fur, huge ivory fanged jaw, raised crimson hackles, glowing red eyes, fiery branching back patches, muscular forepaws, ivory claws and bushy red-tipped tail. NO redesign, horns, wings or armor.
Exactly SIXTEEN separate complete poses on an evenly spaced FOUR ROW × FOUR COLUMN invisible grid, square1024x1024 canvas preferred. One same-size character per cell, ample transparent gutter, no labels/grid/text/floor/shadow/checkerboard. TRUE alpha background. Each character including tail and glow completely inside its cell, not touching neighboring cells or canvas edges. Match pixel-art detail of supplied production reference: crisp square pixels, stepped thin dark contour, restrained3–4tone material clusters, warm upper-left light, no blurry glow/smooth painted illustration. All pixels depict ONE consistent elevated orthographic top-down three-quarter overworld camera.
ALL SIXTEEN POSES FACE DOWN / TOWARD VIEWER, as the FRONT pose in approved concept. Never turn into left/right profile during run or attack. Face visible head-on with shoulders/paws top planes visible. Same fixed front-facing design and scale across every cell.
ROW1 col1–2: idle A/B, subtle breathing and hackle/paw flame variation, FOUR legs and fangs readable. ROW1 col3–4: hurt recoil A/B, flinch and recover, not attack.
ROW2 four distinct running keyposes: compressed gather, forelegs extending with hind legs tucked, forepaw plant, hindleg push. Consistent four-legged canine locomotion, never bipedal. Keep camera facing front/down in ALL run poses.
ROW3 four distinct lunging BITE attack poses: low jaw anticipation; jaws open forepaws lift; aggressive forward reaching paws and bite contact with red eyes/jaw aimed DOWN toward viewer; recovery crouch. No detached claw slash/projectile/VFX. Compact paw/back fire stays connected to body.
ROW4 four distinct DEATH poses: knees buckle/head lowers; collapse forward/side while preserving down-facing head axis; settles on belly; complete fallen dog body, jaws closed and back/paw flames dying. No blood, bones, dismemberment, disappearing body or disconnected rubble. Keep tail attached and consistent fur anatomy.
All16 poses must be different authored drawings, not translated/rotated/scaled copies of a static image. No ground marks/shadows. Only this same FRONT-facing Demon Hound, no hero, palette, inset, extra direction or other creature.

One complete same-size figure per equal cell with generous transparent gutters; full staff/axe/tail/horns clear of every cell edge. No text, labels, grid lines, floor/contact shadows, checkerboard, detached VFX, palette, hero or extra character. Fire only tiny connected hand/paw/back glows, no detached particles.
ROW1: idleA, idleB, hurt-recoilA, hurt-recoverB.
ROW2: four genuinely distinct locomotion phases: left stride/gather, passing/extend, opposite stride/foreplant, opposite passing/hindpush.
ROW3: four distinct attack keyposes anticipation, windup, contact/release, recovery. Lock ALL attacks to SCREEN-LEFT. No turning toward viewer to attack.
ROW4: four death phases buckle, collapse, settle, full fallen body. No blood/dismemberment, fragment pile, vanishing corpse, empty frame or lost equipment. Keep body/weapon touching so poses are separable. Different drawings, no transformed still-image repeats.
Ma Khuyển: low FOUR-legged charcoal/crimson Demon Hound with oversized ivory fanged muzzle, red eyes, crimson hackles,3 compact burning back patches, glowing clawed forepaws and bushy crimson-tipped tail. No horns/wings/armor. Run is a genuine four-legged bound (gather, extend, foreplant, hind push); attack low anticipation, jaw-open windup, leaping bite/paws extending toward SCREEN-LEFT, recovery. Tail on RIGHT, nose on LEFT in every pose. Death entire dog buckles, falls along left-facing axis, settles into complete side-lying attached body, flames diminish.

Use case: stylized-concept / production pixel sprite poses. Produce exactly SIXTEEN authored animation drawings for the single approved enemy, on an evenly spaced FOUR ROW × FOUR COLUMN INVISIBLE grid on true transparent PNG, preferably square1024x1024. Reproduce the exact costume, face/head, weapons, colors, proportions and elevated orthographic top-down three-quarter overworld camera. Match crisp pixel clusters, thin stepped dark outlines, warm upper-left highlights and limited material shades; no smooth illustration, blur, painted checkerboard, labels, grid lines, shadows, floor, text, hero or extra character. Each complete pose centered inside its own equal cell with large transparent gutters and clearance for weapon tips. Keep ONE fixed character size, no cell-to-cell zoom. All16 drawings FACE FRONT/DOWN toward viewer, same direction during walk, attack, hurt and death; never turn into side profile. Anatomical right hand is viewer-left.
ROW1: col1 idleA, col2 idleB, col3 hurt/recoilA, col4 hurt/recoverB.
ROW2: FOUR distinct locomotion poses: left stride, passing, right stride, opposite passing. Maintain front/down facing and stable head/body dimensions.
ROW3: FOUR distinct attack poses: anticipation, wind-up/channel, clear contact/release, recovery. Maintain front/down facing. Character equipment and connected hand glow only; do not draw detached projectiles or impacts in these cells.
ROW4: FOUR distinct death poses: buckle, collapse, settling, complete fallen body. Preserve whole body/clothes/equipment connected; no blood, dismemberment, disconnected debris, vanishing body or empty last frame.
Every animation phase must be a genuinely different drawing, not a transformed still image. Keep all limbs, horns, staff or axe fully inside each cell. Detached floating particles omitted; VFX made separately.
Tiểu Hỏa Quỷ / Fire Imp. Small lean orange/vermilion humanoid, TWO short dark curved horns, pointed ears, yellow glowing eyes, little fang grin, clawed bare hands/feet, dark-purple ragged waist wrap, crimson tie and crossed dark chest straps, small dark-tipped arrow tail. Same TWO horns and body/strap/tail in all16. Compact hand flames connected to palms. Movement quick agile steps. Attack draw hand back with compact flame, cup a small connected fireball in palm, thrust hand directly toward viewer/down to cast, recover; no projectile detached from hand. Death horns/tail stay attached and recognizable while small hand flames fade; final imp body collapsed on ground. Do not turn into bull demon or add armor/weapon.
